app.tagline: The register for design decisions that Figma, Claude Design, Pencil and code check against.

home.title: Projects
home.lead: Every repository has a register. Whatever Figma, Pencil, Claude Design or code change in it comes to you as a decision.
home.broken: Accord could not read this project.
home.brokenHint: Is there a register yet? Run this once in the repository:

onboarding.title: No project connected yet
onboarding.lead: decivo Accord is the register for design decisions: one truth in the repository that Figma, Pencil, Claude Design, code and agents check against.
onboarding.stepsTitle: Your first project in three steps

step1.title: Create the register
step1.text: Run this in your design system's repository. Accord reads tokens, stylesheets and the UI kit and creates the .accord/ folder.

step2.title: Add the project
step2.text: In apps/web/.env.local, add the repository to ACCORD_PROJECTS (template: .env.example). root is the path to the repository.

step3.title: Restart the web app
step3.text: The project then shows up here, with its overview and the open decisions.

how.driftValues: The register has {register}, code has {code}. Replace {code} with {register} in code.
how.deletedText: Deleted in {tool, select, figma {Figma} pen {Pencil} code {code} other {Claude Design}}, still in the register. Restore {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} there. If the deletion should stay, submit it with the command under “For developers” and decide it under Decisions.
how.conflictText: The register and {tool, select, figma {Figma} pen {Pencil} code {code} other {Claude Design}} changed the same thing differently. Submit the change with the command under “For developers”, then decide under Decisions which value counts.
how.surfaceChangeText: Changed in {tool, select, figma {Figma} pen {Pencil} code {code} other {Claude Design}}, but not submitted yet. Submit {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} with the command under “For developers”, then decide under Decisions.
how.firstSyncText: Accord does not know yet which side is newer. Submit the state with the command under “For developers”, then decide per token which value counts.
how.behindText: {count, plural, one {One token was} other {# tokens were}} changed in the register. Copy the new values into {tool, select, figma {Figma} pen {Pencil} code {code} other {Claude Design}}.
how.revertText: {tool, select, figma {Figma} pen {Pencil} code {code} other {Claude Design}} shows {count, plural, one {this token} other {these tokens}} differently from the register, or deleted {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}. Restore the register's values in {tool, select, figma {Figma} pen {Pencil} code {code} other {Claude Design}}. If a deletion should stay, submit it with the command under “For developers” and decide it under Decisions.
how.unreadableText: Save the file again in {tool, select, figma {Figma} pen {Pencil} code {code} other {Claude Design}} and put it back into the repository. Accord reports: {error}
how.toolUnmappedText: The register does not know {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} yet, e.g. {examples}. Submit {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} with the command under “For developers”, then decide under Decisions.
how.literalsText: {count, plural, one {One value} other {# values}} in Pencil {count, plural, one {has} other {have}} no variable. Link them in Pencil to a variable from the register.
how.hardWithReplacement: {exact, plural, one {One value already has} other {# values already have}} a matching token, e.g. {replacements}. Replace the values in code with these tokens.
how.hardNoToken: None of the values matches a token exactly. Ask Design which token applies: a new colour is a decision for design.
how.unmappedText: The register does not know them yet, e.g. {examples}. Replace them in code with matching tokens, or ask Design for new ones.
how.missingText: These tokens are in the register, but code has no CSS variable for them. Copy the lines below into {file, select, none {your stylesheet} other {{file}}}.
how.noFilesText: With the current pattern Accord finds no code file. Add the folders with your code.
how.followText: The decision is {register}, code still has {code}. Replace {code} with {register} in code.
